name: @office/adapters-sdk
description: Office provider-neutral integration SDK (OFF-020): the Adapter contract every provider adapter (OFF-021+) implements — source identity mapping (provider ids to canonical office ids, never primary keys), replay-safe sync cursors, explicit conflict records, provider snapshots, and webhook normalization. Ports only: no I/O, no SQL, no clock, no randomness; depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, and @office/events.
